revenueModel.text: The company is paid by distributors, drug wholesalers, and medical product marketers who buy its cosmetic ingredients, pharmaceuticals and medical lubricants outright for resale.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our cosmetic ingredients directly to those distributors, which in turn resell our products to their customers for use in the formulation of one or more of the customers' personal care and cosmetic products.
